This Certificate does not bestow any form of legal international approval. Zervos                                    Dr. R. Schwartz Direktor und Professor                           Direktor und Professor 13.03.2009                                     13.03.2009 The load cells (LC) of the series MP79, MP79T are bending beam load cells made of stainless steel.
